text: The rental terms are an additive column set on `asset` in `rwb_asset` - the rental start date, the tenant reference, the rental term in months, the rent, the rent currency, the payment method and the auto-debit reference - created by the DB story of this service under ASM-A6-table ownership of S5 and DP-15; the rwb-payment auto-debit request and the rwb-case case-move answer are consumed rows whose operation names stay pending; the arrears follow-up is rwb-payment's under FEAT-PAY-09 with the notice requested from rwb-comms and no threshold value written; ATS is an external system tracked and not built; and the step is named rentHeldAsset.
why: TSD S5 T3.1 gives `asset` no rental column and `asset_sale` sale columns only, the FSD A2.24.3.2 field catalog names v_ace_npa_asset columns only, no source names the auto-debit or case-move operation, and no source gives the arrears threshold, the ATS interface or an activity name.
